# TassieNow

Canonical site: https://tassienow.com/
Sitemap: https://tassienow.com/sitemap.xml
Updates feed: https://tassienow.com/feed.xml

TassieNow is an independent Tasmanian discovery directory for locals and visitors.

Primary content:
- Tasmanian attractions and things to do
- walks, nature and outdoor destinations
- markets, local produce and food destinations
- museums, galleries, wildlife and family activities
- current Tasmanian events
- town and regional discovery pages

Public listing pages are intended for search and information retrieval. Time-sensitive details such as opening hours, event dates, prices and bookings should be confirmed with the linked official source.

Administrative pages and authenticated backend functions are not public content.
